name: test_recorded_files_only_exits_0
expected_result: When every file under inputs/ is recorded, the run exits 0.

name: test_recorded_files_only_prints_nothing
expected_result: When every file under inputs/ is recorded, nothing is printed.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, nothing at all is printed, even when a file is unrecorded.

name: test_quiet_keeps_the_exit_code
expected_result: With the quiet option, the exit code still reports the unrecorded file.

name: test_own_files_are_not_reported
expected_result: A README.md and a .gitkeep under inputs/ are the project's own files and are not reported as unrecorded.

name: test_lock_file_is_not_reported
expected_result: An Excel ~$ lock file beside a workbook under inputs/ is not data and is not reported as unrecorded.

name: test_missing_inputs_folder_is_clean
expected_result: A repo with no inputs/ folder at all has nothing unrecorded and exits 0, as on a fresh clone before anything is downloaded.

name: test_unrecorded_file_exits_10
expected_result: A file under inputs/ that no manifest records makes the run exit 10.

name: test_unrecorded_file_is_listed_by_path
expected_result: An unrecorded file is printed by its repo-relative path.

name: test_unrecorded_file_summary_says_it_cannot_be_restored
expected_result: The summary counts the unrecorded files and says they cannot be restored from a clone.

name: test_part_file_is_reported
expected_result: An unfinished .part download under inputs/ is reported as unrecorded, since acquire_sources did not get to finish it.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_exits_3
expected_result: A manifest that is not valid JSON makes the run exit 3, and the message names the file and says it cannot be read.

name: test_no_manifests_exits_3
expected_result: An empty manifests folder makes the run exit 3, and the message says no manifests were found and how to restore them.

name: test_not_inside_the_repo_exits_6
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the run exits 6 with the install command, instead of reporting that no manifests were found.

name: test_complete_header_exits_0
expected_result: A file whose header holds the eight fields in order makes the run exit 0.

name: test_complete_header_prints_nothing
expected_result: When every header is complete, nothing is printed.

name: test_init_file_is_skipped
expected_result: An __init__.py with a one-paragraph docstring and no header block is not a problem, since a package marker names the folder rather than describing a script.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, nothing is printed even when a header is incomplete; the exit code is the whole report.

name: test_missing_fields_exit_17
expected_result: A header lacking fields makes the run exit 17, and the problem line names the file and every missing field.

name: test_fields_out_of_order_exit_17
expected_result: A header with its fields in the wrong order makes the run exit 17, and the problem line says so and shows the order found.

name: test_bad_date_exits_17
expected_result: A Date that is not a plain calendar date makes the run exit 17, and the problem line quotes the value found.

name: test_no_docstring_exits_17
expected_result: A file with no module docstring has no header block at all: the run exits 17 and the problem line says so.

name: test_unparseable_file_exits_19
expected_result: A file that is not valid Python makes the run exit 19, and the problem line says it cannot be parsed.

name: test_unparseable_outranks_incomplete
expected_result: When one file cannot be parsed and another has an incomplete header, the run exits 19, and both problems are still named.

name: test_wording_from_the_table_passes
expected_result: An entry written with the wording in validation/exit_codes.csv for its number passes.

name: test_a_bracketed_aside_is_allowed
expected_result: An entry may add a bracketed aside after the wording in validation/exit_codes.csv, saying what the cause means in that file.

name: test_a_wrapped_entry_is_read_as_one
expected_result: An entry too long for one line is joined before it is compared, so wrapping it does not make it disagree.

name: test_a_lone_wrapped_entry_keeps_its_second_line
expected_result: An entry that wraps and is the last thing in the field keeps its second line, so a header holding one long entry and no closing prose is not refused as wording that disagrees with validation/exit_codes.csv.

name: test_the_closing_prose_is_not_read_as_an_entry
expected_result: The sentence a field ends with is not mistaken for an entry, so it is never compared with validation/exit_codes.csv.

name: test_a_code_the_table_lacks_exits_33
expected_result: An entry for a number validation/exit_codes.csv does not hold makes the run exit 33, and the problem line names the file and the number.

name: test_different_wording_exits_33
expected_result: An entry giving a number a second meaning makes the run exit 33, and the problem line prints what the header says beside what validation/exit_codes.csv says.

name: test_an_incomplete_header_outranks_a_wrong_code
expected_result: When one file has an incomplete header and another has a wrong code, the run exits 17, because a header that cannot be read is the worse problem.

name: test_an_unreadable_table_exits_13
expected_result: With validation/exit_codes.csv missing, the run exits 13 and says the file cannot be read, rather than reporting every file as disagreeing with nothing.

name: test_a_table_with_a_code_that_is_not_a_number_exits_13
expected_result: With a row of validation/exit_codes.csv holding a code that is not a number, the run exits 13 and says that file cannot be read, naming it, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_a_listed_return_passes
expected_result: A code main() returns and the header lists is no problem.

name: test_a_return_of_a_call_is_passed_over
expected_result: A return of something other than a plain number is passed over rather than guessed at, so a computed exit code is never reported as unlisted.

name: test_a_listed_code_that_is_never_returned_is_not_a_problem
expected_result: A header may list a code main() does not return as a plain number, because the check only looks for codes a header forgot.

name: test_a_nested_helpers_return_is_not_read_as_mains
expected_result: A number returned by a helper function defined inside main() is the helper's, not main()'s, so a header that does not list it is not refused.

name: test_an_unlisted_return_exits_34
expected_result: A code main() returns that the header does not list makes the run exit 34, and the problem line names the file and the number.

name: test_both_sides_of_a_one_line_choice_are_read[unlisted code first]
expected_result: A return written as a one-line choice is read on both sides, so the branch that is not listed is still caught whichever side it sits on.

name: test_both_sides_of_a_one_line_choice_are_read[unlisted code second]
expected_result: A return written as a one-line choice is read on both sides, so the branch that is not listed is still caught whichever side it sits on.

name: test_an_incomplete_header_outranks_a_forgotten_code
expected_result: When one file has no header and another forgets a code its main() returns, the run exits 17, because a header that cannot be read is the worse problem, and both problems are named.

name: test_a_forgotten_code_outranks_a_reworded_one
expected_result: When one file forgets a code and another rewords one, the run exits 34, because a missing code is the worse problem.

name: test_real_headers_follow_the_rule
expected_result: Every Python file in the real code folders has a header block with the eight fields in order and a valid Date, as .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md requires.

name: test_real_exit_codes_agree_with_the_table_and_main
expected_result: In every Python file in the real code folders, each exit code the header lists opens with the wording validation/exit_codes.csv gives it, and each code main() returns as a plain number is listed.

name: test_all_four_code_folders_are_checked
expected_result: The checker covers the four folders .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md names, so a file added under any of them is held to the header block like any other. The check compares with its own copy of the four, not with the rule file itself.

name: test_missing_file_is_fetched_and_placed
expected_result: A recorded file not on disk ends up under its final name with the bytes the server sent, and the run exits 0.

name: test_fetched_file_leaves_no_part_file
expected_result: After a file is fetched and placed, nothing is left under its .part name.

name: test_fetch_is_reported
expected_result: The report names the file as fetching and counts it as fetched.

name: test_present_matching_file_is_not_fetched
expected_result: A file already on disk that matches its entry is not downloaded, and the run exits 0.

name: test_present_matching_file_is_counted_as_present
expected_result: The report counts a matching file as present and fetches nothing.

name: test_dry_run_names_each_file_it_would_fetch
expected_result: With the dry-run option, each missing file is named as one the run would fetch, and they are counted.

name: test_dry_run_touches_neither_network_nor_disk
expected_result: With the dry-run option, nothing is downloaded and nothing is written.

name: test_dry_run_exits_8_when_a_file_is_missing
expected_result: With the dry-run option, the run exits 8 when at least one file would need fetching, because a pinned file has not been downloaded.

name: test_dry_run_exits_0_when_the_corpus_is_complete
expected_result: With the dry-run option, the run exits 0 when every file is present and matching, so a quiet dry run answers whether the pinned files are complete from the exit code alone.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, nothing at all is printed, even when a file is fetched.

name: test_set_fetches_only_that_manifests_files
expected_result: With the set option naming one manifest, only that manifest's files are fetched.

name: test_set_does_not_read_the_other_manifests
expected_result: With --set, a manifest that was not named is not even read: an unreadable one does not stop the run.

name: test_changed_file_is_reported_as_a_mismatch
expected_result: A file on disk that no longer matches its entry is reported as a MISMATCH on its sha256 and as left alone.

name: test_changed_file_is_left_alone
expected_result: A changed file is neither replaced nor deleted; its bytes are as they were.

name: test_changed_file_exits_9
expected_result: A changed file on disk makes the run exit 9, and the summary says a person has to look.

name: test_wrong_hash_download_is_discarded
expected_result: A download whose bytes do not match the entry is reported as DISCARDED and appears under neither the final name nor the .part name.

name: test_wrong_hash_download_exits_12
expected_result: A discarded download makes the run exit 12 and is counted as a failed fetch.

name: test_failed_fetch_is_reported_with_its_cause
expected_result: A url that cannot be fetched is reported as FAILED with the cause.

name: test_failed_fetch_exits_11
expected_result: A failed fetch makes the run exit 11.

name: test_failure_outranks_disagreement
expected_result: With one file changed on disk and another that cannot be fetched, both are reported and the exit code is 11, because a missing file is worse than a changed one.

name: test_dry_run_missing_file_outranks_disagreement
expected_result: In a dry run too, a file that would need fetching outranks a changed file: both are reported and the exit code is 8, not 9.

name: test_wrong_hash_download_outranks_disagreement
expected_result: With one file changed on disk and another whose download does not match its entry, both are reported and the exit code is 12, not 9, because a file still missing is worse than a changed one.

name: test_failed_fetch_outranks_a_discarded_download
expected_result: With one file that cannot be fetched and another whose download does not match its entry, both are reported and the exit code is 11, not 12, because a file nothing could be downloaded for is worse than one whose download was discarded.

name: test_disagreement_outranks_an_unreadable_file
expected_result: With one file changed on disk and a folder where another file should be, both are reported and the exit code is 9, not 13.

name: test_locked_file_is_reported_as_cannot_read_with_the_cause
expected_result: A recorded file that cannot be opened is reported as CANNOT READ with the cause and as left alone, rather than ending the run with a traceback.

name: test_locked_file_exits_13
expected_result: A recorded file that cannot be opened makes the run exit 13.

name: test_folder_at_a_recorded_path_is_reported_as_cannot_read
expected_result: A folder where a recorded file should be is reported as CANNOT READ, a folder not a file, and as left alone.

name: test_folder_at_a_recorded_path_exits_13
expected_result: A folder where a recorded file should be makes the run exit 13.

name: test_entry_missing_a_field_exits_3_naming_the_field
expected_result: An entry lacking a required field stops the run with exit 3, and the message names the field.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_exits_3_naming_the_file
expected_result: A manifest that is not valid JSON stops the run with exit 3, and the message names the file.

name: test_unknown_set_exits_3_naming_it
expected_result: With the set option naming a manifest that does not exist, the run exits 3 and the message names it.

name: test_not_in_repo_exits_6_with_the_install_command
expected_result: The sdg package, when not running from inside its repo, exits 6, and the message gives the install command.

name: test_repo_check_runs_before_any_manifest_is_read
expected_result: With a wrong package name and an unreadable manifest, the run exits 6 and not 3, which shows the repo check came first.

name: test_download_is_written_under_the_part_name
expected_result: A completed download is written to <destination>.part, and that path is handed back.

name: test_download_holds_the_bytes_the_server_sent
expected_result: The .part file holds exactly the bytes the server sent, in order.

name: test_nothing_appears_under_the_final_name
expected_result: A completed download does not create the final name; that is the place step's job.

name: test_missing_folders_are_created
expected_result: The folders on the way to the destination are created when they do not exist.

name: test_leftover_part_file_is_replaced
expected_result: A .part file left by an earlier run is replaced by the new download, not added to.

name: test_request_is_a_get_on_the_given_url
expected_result: The request is a GET on the url fetch() was given.

name: test_request_asks_to_follow_redirects
expected_result: The request asks the HTTP library to follow a redirect, so a file the server has moved is still found.

name: test_request_carries_the_module_timeout
expected_result: The request gives up after the number of seconds fetch_file.py sets.

name: test_partial_path_adds_part_to_the_file_name
expected_result: partial_path() adds .part to the file name and keeps the folder.

name: test_error_status_raises_fetch_error_naming_url_and_status
expected_result: A server that answers with an error status makes fetch() raise FetchError, and the message names the url and the status.

name: test_error_status_leaves_no_part_file
expected_result: After an error status, no .part file is left on disk.

name: test_unreachable_server_raises_fetch_error_naming_url_and_cause
expected_result: A connection that cannot be made makes fetch() raise FetchError, and the message names the url and the cause.

name: test_unreachable_server_leaves_no_part_file
expected_result: After a failed connection, no .part file is left on disk.

name: test_unparseable_url_raises_fetch_error_naming_url_and_cause
expected_result: A url the HTTP library cannot parse makes fetch() raise FetchError, and the message names the url and the cause, so acquire_sources counts it and carries on rather than stopping with a traceback.

name: test_file_where_the_folder_should_be_raises_fetch_error
expected_result: A plain file sitting where the destination's folder should be makes fetch() raise FetchError naming the url, and the file is left as it was.

name: test_a_failed_cleanup_does_not_mask_the_fetch_error
expected_result: When the .part file cannot be removed after a failed download, fetch() still raises FetchError for the download, not the removal's own error.

name: test_broken_transfer_raises_fetch_error_naming_the_cause
expected_result: A transfer that breaks after the first chunk makes fetch() raise FetchError, and the message names the cause.

name: test_broken_transfer_removes_the_half_written_part_file
expected_result: After a transfer breaks part way, the half-written .part file is removed, so it cannot be mistaken for a finished download.

name: test_place_puts_the_file_under_its_final_name
expected_result: After place(), the bytes are at the final name.

name: test_place_hands_back_the_final_path
expected_result: place() gives back the final path.

name: test_place_removes_the_part_name
expected_result: After place(), nothing is left under the .part name.

name: test_discard_deletes_the_part_file
expected_result: discard() deletes the .part file and gives back nothing.

name: test_place_refuses_when_the_final_name_is_taken
expected_result: When a file already sits at the final name, place() raises FileExistsError, and the message names that file and says to run acquire_sources again after dealing with it.

name: test_refused_place_leaves_the_existing_file_untouched
expected_result: When placing a download is refused because a file is already at the final name, that file keeps its bytes.

name: test_refused_place_leaves_the_part_file_where_it_was
expected_result: When placing a download is refused because a file is already at the final name, the .part file stays where it was, with its bytes.

name: test_place_refuses_a_missing_part_file
expected_result: place() raises FileNotFoundError naming the path when the .part file does not exist.

name: test_place_refuses_a_name_without_the_part_suffix
expected_result: place() raises ValueError naming the path when the name does not end in .part.

name: test_place_leaves_a_file_it_refused_untouched
expected_result: A file place() refused for its name keeps its bytes.

name: test_discard_refuses_a_missing_part_file
expected_result: discard() raises FileNotFoundError naming the path when the .part file does not exist.

name: test_discard_refuses_a_name_without_the_part_suffix
expected_result: discard() raises ValueError naming the path when the name does not end in .part.

name: test_discard_leaves_a_file_it_refused_in_place
expected_result: A file discard() refused for its name is not deleted, so a pinned file can never be discarded by mistake.

name: test_fingerprint_measures_the_size
expected_result: fingerprint() gives back the file's size in bytes.

name: test_fingerprint_measures_the_sha256
expected_result: fingerprint() gives back the file's sha256, the same as an independent hash of the same bytes.

name: test_reading_in_pieces_loses_nothing
expected_result: A file bigger than the piece fingerprint_file.py reads at a time hashes the same as a hash of the whole file.

name: test_matching_file_compares_as_matched
expected_result: A file whose size and sha256 equal its entry's compares as matched.

name: test_size_difference_is_reported_with_both_numbers
expected_result: When the size differs from the entry, the result is not matched and the detail gives the file's size and the manifest's.

name: test_size_difference_skips_the_hash
expected_result: When the size differs, the sha256 is not computed at all.

name: test_same_size_different_bytes_is_reported_as_sha256_difference
expected_result: When the size matches but the bytes differ, the result is not matched and the detail shows the start of both sha256 values.

name: test_fingerprint_refuses_a_missing_file
expected_result: fingerprint() raises FileNotFoundError naming the path when the file does not exist.

name: test_compare_refuses_a_missing_file
expected_result: compare() raises FileNotFoundError naming the path when the file does not exist.

name: test_fingerprint_refuses_a_folder
expected_result: fingerprint() raises FileNotFoundError naming the path when a folder sits at the path, because only a file can be measured.

name: test_compare_refuses_a_folder
expected_result: compare() raises FileNotFoundError naming the path when a folder sits at the path.

name: test_repo_root_is_the_folder_holding_pyproject
expected_result: require_repo() gives back the folder that holds pyproject.toml.

name: test_every_entry_names_the_manifest_it_came_from
expected_result: Every entry remembers which manifest file it was read from.

name: test_every_manifest_lands_under_inputs
expected_result: Every real manifest, wherever it sits under manifests/, says its files land under inputs/.

name: test_every_entry_carries_the_five_required_fields
expected_result: Every entry in every real manifest has a name, a url, a local path under inputs/, a size above zero, and a 64-character sha256.

name: test_study_manifest_is_read_with_the_top_level_ones
expected_result: A manifest under manifests/study_documents/ is read in the same call as the top-level manifests.

name: test_study_manifests_are_listed_after_the_top_level_ones
expected_result: The study manifests come after the top-level ones in the list.

name: test_manifests_are_listed_in_path_order
expected_result: Manifests come back sorted by path, whatever order they were written in.

name: test_listing_order_is_the_same_on_every_call
expected_result: Two calls give the manifests in the same order.

name: test_one_manifest_can_be_read_by_name
expected_result: Asking for a manifest by name gives only that one.

name: test_the_name_may_carry_the_json_suffix
expected_result: Asking by the file name with its .json suffix gives that same one manifest.

name: test_entry_for_finds_a_recorded_file
expected_result: entry_for() gives back the entry that records a file, given the repo-relative path a manifest writes.

name: test_entry_for_accepts_backslashes
expected_result: A repo-relative path written with backslashes finds the same entry.

name: test_entry_for_accepts_a_full_path
expected_result: A full Path to the file finds the same entry.

name: test_entry_path_is_the_file_on_this_machine
expected_result: An entry's path is the full path of its file on this machine.

name: test_entry_for_gives_none_for_an_unrecorded_file
expected_result: A file that no manifest records gives None, not an error.

name: test_entry_named_finds_a_recorded_file_by_its_name
expected_result: entry_named() gives back the entry whose file name is the one asked for, so a caller holding only the name never writes the path down a second time.

name: test_entry_named_gives_none_for_a_name_no_manifest_records
expected_result: A file name that no manifest records gives None from entry_named(), not an error.

name: test_a_relative_path_is_read_from_the_repo_root
expected_result: A relative Path finds the same entry as the repo-relative string, whichever folder the program was started from, so a command run from elsewhere never reports a recorded file as unrecorded.

name: test_as_local_leaves_an_outside_path_unchanged
expected_result: A path outside the repo comes back from as_local() as its full path, so a message about it can show where it is.

name: test_wrong_package_name_is_refused_with_the_install_command
expected_result: When pyproject.toml does not name the sdg package, manifests() raises NotInRepoError and the message gives the pip install -e . command.

name: test_repo_check_runs_before_any_manifest_is_read
expected_result: With a wrong package name and an unreadable manifest, the error is about the sdg package, which shows the repo check came first.

name: test_missing_manifests_folder_is_named_with_the_restore_remedy
expected_result: When manifests/ is missing, the error names the folder and says to restore it with git.

name: test_empty_manifests_folder_is_reported_as_none_found
expected_result: When manifests/ holds no manifest, the error says none were found and says to restore them with git.

name: test_unknown_manifest_name_is_refused_by_name
expected_result: Asking for a manifest by a name no file has gives an error that quotes the name.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_stops_the_read_and_names_the_file
expected_result: A manifest that is not valid JSON stops the whole read, even when another manifest is fine, with an error naming the bad file and the git restore remedy.

name: test_manifest_that_is_a_list_is_refused_naming_the_file
expected_result: A manifest whose JSON is valid but is a list rather than an object is refused as unreadable, naming the file and the git restore remedy, rather than failing inside the entry reader.

name: test_entry_that_is_not_an_object_is_refused_naming_the_file
expected_result: A manifest whose files list holds a bare value rather than an entry object is refused as unreadable, naming the file and the git restore remedy.

name: test_entry_missing_fields_has_every_missing_field_named
expected_result: An entry lacking required fields is refused with one message that names the manifest, the entry, every missing field, and the repair remedy.

name: test_size_that_is_not_a_whole_number_is_quoted_as_written
expected_result: A size written as "12,345" is refused as not a whole number, quoting the value as written, with the repair remedy.

name: test_sha256_that_is_not_lowercase_hex_is_quoted_as_written
expected_result: A sha256 in uppercase is refused as not 64 lowercase hex characters, quoting the value as written, with the repair remedy.

name: test_real_file_carries_its_recorded_identity
expected_result: The pinned model file comes back with the sha256, url and manifest name its manifest entry records.

name: test_real_file_path_is_where_the_manifest_says
expected_result: The pinned model file's path is the repo root plus the local path its entry records.

name: test_real_file_content_reads
expected_result: read_text() on the pinned model file gives its text, which opens with the first class in the model.

name: test_real_file_record_is_the_same_by_string_or_path
expected_result: The repo-relative string a manifest writes, the same string with backslashes, and a full Path all give the same record.

name: test_pinned_file_is_unchanged[inputs/standards/cdisc/biomedical_concepts_2026-07-14/BC_Overview_Training.pdf]
expected_result: A pinned file on disk has the size and sha256 its manifest entry records, so it is unchanged since it was pinned. A file not downloaded is skipped.

expected_result: A pinned file on disk has the size and sha256 its manifest entry records, so it is unchanged since it was pinned. A file not downloaded is skipped.

name: test_pinned_file_is_unchanged[inputs/standards/cdisc/usdm_v4/USDM_API.yaml]
expected_result: A pinned file on disk has the size and sha256 its manifest entry records, so it is unchanged since it was pinned. A file not downloaded is skipped.

name: test_pinned_file_is_unchanged[inputs/standards/cdisc/usdm_v4/USDM_CORE_Rules.xlsx]
expected_result: A pinned file on disk has the size and sha256 its manifest entry records, so it is unchanged since it was pinned. A file not downloaded is skipped.

name: test_recorded_file_carries_its_identity
expected_result: A file whose entry is correct comes back with the sha256, url and manifest name its entry records.

name: test_recorded_file_path_is_the_file_on_this_machine
expected_result: A verified file's path is the full path of the file on this machine, and its local path is the one the manifest writes.

name: test_recorded_file_content_reads
expected_result: read_text() on a verified file gives its content.

name: test_staged_record_is_the_same_by_string_or_path
expected_result: A repo-relative string and a full Path to the same staged file give the same record.

name: test_not_in_repo_error_passes_through_unwrapped
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, verify_pinned() raises NotInRepoError with the install command, not an IntegrityError.

name: test_recorded_but_absent_file_raises_file_not_found
expected_result: A file that a manifest records but that is not on disk raises FileNotFoundError naming the path, a different failure from a file that cannot be verified.

name: test_locked_file_passes_the_operating_systems_error_through
expected_result: A recorded file that is on disk but cannot be opened raises PermissionError unchanged, naming the path, rather than being wrapped as a mismatch or a missing file.

name: test_unrecorded_file_is_refused_as_unrecorded
expected_result: A file that no manifest records is refused with a message saying so and the remedy of adding an entry.

name: test_unrecorded_file_does_not_get_the_mismatch_remedy
expected_result: The message for an unrecorded file does not carry the mismatch remedy, which would send a person to re-download a file that was never recorded.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_is_reported_as_a_manifest_problem
expected_result: A manifest that cannot be read is passed through as the manifest reader's own error from src/sdg/sources/read_manifests.py, naming the manifest file and the git restore remedy.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_does_not_get_the_mismatch_remedy
expected_result: The message for an unreadable manifest does not carry the mismatch remedy, because the file is not the problem.

name: test_no_manifests_is_reported_as_none_found
expected_result: When the manifests folder is empty, the refusal says no manifests were found and says to restore them with git.

name: test_entry_missing_sha256_is_reported_as_lacking_it
expected_result: An entry with no sha256 is refused as lacking that field, with the repair remedy, so a person repairs the entry rather than re-downloading.

name: test_mismatch_shows_both_sha256_values
expected_result: When the bytes differ from the entry at the same size, the message shows the start of the file's sha256 and of the manifest's.

name: test_mismatch_names_the_manifest_that_records_the_file
expected_result: The mismatch message names the manifest the file is recorded in.

name: test_mismatch_offers_the_three_ways_back
expected_result: The mismatch message offers the three ways back: re-fetch, read unverified once, or re-pin.

name: test_size_mismatch_is_reported_as_size_with_both_numbers
expected_result: When the size differs from the entry, the refusal reports a size difference with the file's size and the manifest's.

name: test_passing_run_is_recorded_as_pass
expected_result: A suite whose tests all pass gets a report saying PASS, with pytest's exit status 0 and its meaning on every row.

name: test_a_passing_check_gets_a_row_with_its_details
expected_result: A check that passed gets one row carrying its id, its category, its objective, its staged case, its expected result and the outcome passed.

name: test_a_skipped_check_is_shown_as_skipped_with_its_reason
expected_result: A check that was skipped gets a row saying skipped, with the skip's reason and, since it carries no markers, an empty category, objective and staged case.

name: test_no_flag_writes_nothing
expected_result: Without --validation-report, a run writes no report at all, so development runs leave no trace.

name: test_cleanup_failure_is_recorded_as_fail
expected_result: A test whose own checks pass but whose clean-up step raises an error is a failed run to pytest (exit 1). The report says FAIL, and that test's row says error with 'clean-up failed', never passed.

name: test_failing_assertion_is_recorded_as_fail
expected_result: A test whose checks fail gives a FAIL report with that row marked failed and the assertion message as its reason.

name: test_setup_failure_is_recorded_as_error
expected_result: A test whose set-up step raises an error never runs; the report says FAIL and the row says error.

name: test_file_that_will_not_load_still_gets_a_fail_report
expected_result: When a test file cannot even be loaded (a syntax error), no test runs and pytest exits 2. A report is still written, says FAIL, and holds one row saying that no check ran, so a broken run cannot pass unnoticed by leaving no report behind.

name: test_a_second_report_on_the_same_day_and_commit_gets_a_numbered_name
expected_result: A second report written on the same day at the same commit is given a numbered suffix, and the first report is left exactly as it was.

expected_result: The run_by column carries the user name git is configured with, so a report says who ran it.

name: test_target_file_names_the_mirrored_code_file_and_marks_a_missing_one
expected_result: The target_folder_path and target_file_name columns name the code file the check file mirrors, by the same rule the inventory uses, and the file name is marked when that file is not there, so a check file that mirrors nothing shows as a gap rather than as a target.

name: test_check_file_sha256_is_the_hash_of_the_check_file
expected_result: The check_file_sha256 column is the sha256 of the check file's bytes as they were when the run started, so a report names the exact test code it ran.

name: test_fixture_sha256s_names_each_fixture_file_with_its_hash
expected_result: The fixture_sha256s column names each file in the fixtures folder beside validation/conftest.py with its sha256, so a report says the exact bytes the checks ran on.

name: test_a_check_whose_pinned_file_matches_runs
expected_result: A check whose pinned file is on disk and matches its manifest entry runs, and its row says passed.

name: test_a_check_whose_pinned_file_changed_is_blocked
expected_result: A check whose pinned file no longer matches its manifest entry is skipped as blocked, naming the file, and the run still passes, because only the stability check for that file fails for the change.

name: test_a_check_whose_pinned_file_is_not_downloaded_is_skipped
expected_result: A check whose pinned file is recorded but not on disk is skipped, and the reason names the file and says to run acquire_sources.

name: test_a_check_naming_a_file_no_manifest_records_errors
expected_result: A check whose @needs_pinned names files no manifest records is a mistake in the check, so its set-up fails: the run fails, the row says error, and the terminal names the pattern and says to correct the marker.

name: test_a_real_text_stream_is_switched_to_utf8
expected_result: When standard output is Python's real text-file class, use_utf8_output() switches its encoding to UTF-8 for the rest of the run.

name: test_a_captured_stream_is_left_alone_without_error
expected_result: When standard output is not Python's real text-file class, as when another program has captured it, use_utf8_output() returns without an error and leaves the stream as it was.

name: test_lists_every_class_sorted
expected_result: A well-formed file loads, and class_names() gives every class in alphabetical order, so a listing is stable from run to run.

name: test_abstract_flag_comes_from_modifier
expected_result: is_abstract() reports USDM's own Modifier, so Identifier, a parent never used on its own, is abstract, and StudyIdentifier, its concrete child, is not.

name: test_attributes_keep_file_order_and_inheritance
expected_result: attributes() hands back a class's attributes in the order the file lists them, including the ones copied down from its parent, and each inherited one still names that parent.

name: test_targets_unwraps_one_and_many
expected_result: targets() turns USDM's '$ref: #/X' wrapping into plain names, for an attribute with one target and for the five-way one (Condition.appliesToIds).

name: test_unknown_class_raises_keyerror_naming_it
expected_result: Asking for a class that is not in the file raises KeyError carrying that name, so a typo is reported rather than answered with an empty result.

name: test_empty_file_is_refused
expected_result: An empty file is refused as 'empty or not a mapping' instead of being treated as a model with no classes.

name: test_class_without_modifier_is_named
expected_result: Deleting Modifier from one class is refused with a message naming that class.

name: test_unexpected_modifier_value_is_named
expected_result: A Modifier other than Concrete or Abstract is refused, quoting the unexpected value, so a new USDM vocabulary cannot pass unnoticed.

name: test_attributes_not_a_mapping_is_named
expected_result: Turning a class's Attributes into a list is refused with a message naming the class, before any reading function could trip over it.

name: test_attribute_missing_a_key_is_named
expected_result: Renaming 'Relationship Type' on one attribute is refused with a message naming Class.attribute and the missing key, rather than surfacing later as a KeyError traceback from the attribute printer in usdm_spec.py.

name: test_attribute_missing_several_keys_lists_them
expected_result: When more than one key is missing from an attribute, the message lists all of them, so one read of the error shows the whole problem.

name: test_type_that_is_not_a_reference_list_is_named
expected_result: A Type holding a plain word instead of a list of '$ref' entries is refused, naming Class.attribute and the field, rather than failing later inside the printer when it tries to walk the value.

name: test_empty_type_list_is_refused
expected_result: An attribute whose Type list is empty is refused with a message naming the attribute, because an attribute with no type is not a shape usdm_spec.py can answer questions about.

name: test_inherited_from_without_ref_is_named
expected_result: An Inherited From entry lacking its '$ref' is refused, naming the attribute and the field, so the attribute printer in usdm_spec.py never indexes a missing key.

name: test_missing_file_raises_filenotfound
expected_result: A path that does not exist raises FileNotFoundError (exit 8 at the command line), which is a different failure from a file that fails verification.

name: test_unrecorded_file_is_refused_through_load
expected_result: A file no manifest entry records is refused by load() with the pinned-file check's message saying exactly that, not with the fingerprint-mismatch remedy.

name: test_fingerprint_mismatch_is_refused_through_load
expected_result: A file whose recorded sha256 differs is refused by load() with both values and the recovery paths, including --allow-unpinned.

name: test_cli_no_mode_exits_2
expected_result: Running with no mode flag is a usage error: argparse prints usage and exits 2.

name: test_cli_missing_spec_exits_8
expected_result: When the pinned file is not downloaded, the command exits 8 and tells the user to run acquire_sources.

name: test_cli_unrecorded_spec_exits_10
expected_result: When the file is present but no manifest entry records it, the command exits 10 and prints the cause.

name: test_cli_fingerprint_mismatch_exits_9
expected_result: When the file is present but its sha256 differs from its manifest entry, the command exits 9 and prints both values and the --allow-unpinned way round.

name: test_cli_unreadable_manifest_exits_3
expected_result: When a manifest is not valid JSON, the command exits 3 and names the manifest as the thing that cannot be read, rather than blaming the pinned file.

name: test_cli_not_inside_repo_exits_6[verify]
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the command exits 6 and prints the install command, rather than reporting the spec as missing.

name: test_cli_not_inside_repo_exits_6[allow-unpinned]
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the command exits 6 and prints the install command, rather than reporting the spec as missing.

name: test_cli_wrong_shape_exits_4
expected_result: When the file passes (or skips) verification but is not shaped like USDM, the command exits 4 and names the broken class.

name: test_cli_locked_file_exits_13
expected_result: When the pinned file is on disk but another program has it locked, the command exits 13 and says to close that program, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_cli_malformed_type_exits_4_not_traceback
expected_result: A file whose Type values are not reference lists makes --attributes exit 4 with the attribute named, not crash with a traceback while printing.

name: test_cli_allow_unpinned_reads_the_file
expected_result: With the allow-unpinned option, the manifest check is skipped and a file no manifest records is read in place, listing its classes and exiting 0.

name: test_cli_attributes_prints_type_cardinality_kind
expected_result: The attributes listing prints each attribute's type, cardinality and kind, marks inherited ones with their parent, and exits 0.

name: test_cli_unknown_class_exits_5
expected_result: The attributes listing for a class that does not exist exits 5 and points at the class listing, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_pinned_file_is_shaped_the_way_the_loader_expects
expected_result: The pinned dataStructure.yml passes the loader's two shape checks, so what src/sdg/usdm/usdm_spec.py expects of USDM v4 matches the real file. The file is read without the checksum step, which the stability check for it covers.

name: test_pinned_file_types_are_classes_or_five_primitives
expected_result: Every attribute type in the pinned model is a class in the model or one of the five primitives the docstring of targets() names, and exactly four attributes reference more than one type. The check compares with its own copy of the five and the four, not with the docstring itself.

name: test_fixture_classes_are_identical_to_pinned
expected_result: Each class in the small fixture file is identical, key for key, to the same class in the pinned model, so the checks that ran on the fixture ran on real USDM shapes and not on an approximation of them.

name: test_every_row_becomes_a_document
expected_result: Each row in lookup_documents.yml becomes one document, keyed by the key a person types.

name: test_the_path_comes_from_the_manifest
expected_result: A document's path is taken from its manifest entry, so lookup_documents.yml never states where a file lives.

name: test_the_manifest_is_carried_for_the_missing_file_message
expected_result: A document carries the manifest that records it, which the missing-file message tells a person to restore from.

name: test_boilerplate_patterns_are_compiled
expected_result: A boilerplate pattern is compiled, and it matches the repeated header and footer lines it was written for.

name: test_an_empty_boilerplate_list_strips_nothing
expected_result: A document with nothing repeated on its pages carries no patterns.

name: test_the_default_is_the_one_the_list_names
expected_result: The key used when --doc is absent is the one lookup_documents.yml names as its default.

name: test_docs_names_every_document
expected_result: With every listed document on disk, --docs names each one.

name: test_docs_exits_0_when_every_document_is_present
expected_result: With every listed document on disk, --docs exits 0.

name: test_a_missing_list_is_refused
expected_result: With no list of lookup documents on disk, loading raises RegistryError naming the path and saying to restore it from git.

name: test_a_list_that_is_not_yaml_is_refused
expected_result: A list that is not valid YAML raises RegistryError saying so, rather than failing later with a shape error.

name: test_a_list_with_no_documents_is_refused
expected_result: A file with no documents list raises RegistryError saying which part is absent.

name: test_a_row_missing_a_field_is_refused
expected_result: A row without its label raises RegistryError naming the field that is missing.

name: test_a_row_that_is_not_a_set_of_fields_is_refused
expected_result: A row that is a bare value rather than a set of fields raises RegistryError quoting the value, rather than crashing on the field lookup.

name: test_a_boilerplate_that_is_not_a_list_is_refused[one string]
expected_result: A boilerplate written as anything but a list, a lone pattern string or an empty-looking value, raises RegistryError naming the row, rather than reading the string one character at a time or silently taking it as no patterns.

name: test_a_boilerplate_that_is_not_a_list_is_refused[false]
expected_result: A boilerplate written as anything but a list, a lone pattern string or an empty-looking value, raises RegistryError naming the row, rather than reading the string one character at a time or silently taking it as no patterns.

name: test_a_boilerplate_that_is_not_a_list_is_refused[zero]
expected_result: A boilerplate written as anything but a list, a lone pattern string or an empty-looking value, raises RegistryError naming the row, rather than reading the string one character at a time or silently taking it as no patterns.

name: test_a_boilerplate_that_is_not_a_list_is_refused[empty string]
expected_result: A boilerplate written as anything but a list, a lone pattern string or an empty-looking value, raises RegistryError naming the row, rather than reading the string one character at a time or silently taking it as no patterns.

name: test_a_boilerplate_that_is_not_a_list_is_refused[null]
expected_result: A boilerplate written as anything but a list, a lone pattern string or an empty-looking value, raises RegistryError naming the row, rather than reading the string one character at a time or silently taking it as no patterns.

name: test_a_file_no_manifest_records_is_refused
expected_result: A row naming a file that no manifest records raises UnknownFileError naming the file and saying to correct the name or record the file.

name: test_a_default_that_is_not_listed_is_refused
expected_result: A default naming a key lookup_documents.yml does not hold raises RegistryError, rather than leaving --doc with a default it cannot accept.

name: test_a_missing_list_exits_31
expected_result: When lookup_documents.yml is missing, the command exits 31 and says where the file was expected and how to get it back, rather than raising.

name: test_a_file_no_manifest_records_exits_32
expected_result: When lookup_documents.yml names a file no manifest records, the command exits 32, a different cause from a list that cannot be read.

name: test_not_inside_repo_exits_6
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the command exits 6 and prints the install command, because the manifests that own each document's path cannot be found from anywhere else.

name: test_an_unreadable_manifest_exits_3
expected_result: When a manifest is not valid JSON, the command exits 3 and names that manifest as the thing that cannot be read, rather than blaming lookup_documents.yml or a document.

name: test_docs_exits_8_when_a_document_is_not_downloaded
expected_result: With a listed document recorded but not on disk, --docs exits 8 and says to run acquire_sources.

name: test_a_section_is_found_by_number
expected_result: Asking for a section by its number prints that section's text.

name: test_a_section_is_found_by_title
expected_result: Asking for part of a section's title prints that section.

name: test_the_section_map_lists_every_section
expected_result: The section map names every section the document's bookmarks hold.

name: test_a_page_range_is_printed
expected_result: A page range prints those pages, which is the mode a document without bookmarks is read by.

name: test_a_two_page_range_prints_both_pages_in_order
expected_result: A range of two pages prints both, first page first.

name: test_a_term_is_searched_for_across_pages
expected_result: A search names the page that contains the term and shows the matching line, rather than answering that no page contains it.

name: test_page_furniture_is_stripped
expected_result: A line matching the document's boilerplate pattern is left out of an extract, so a section reads as its own content.

name: test_raw_keeps_the_page_furniture
expected_result: With --raw the boilerplate is kept, for a session that needs the page exactly as it is.

name: test_a_section_that_does_not_exist_exits_23
expected_result: Asking for a section the document does not hold exits 23, rather than printing nothing and reading as though the content were absent.

name: test_section_mode_on_a_document_without_bookmarks_exits_24
expected_result: Asking for a section of a document that carries no bookmarks exits 24 and names the modes that do work on it.

name: test_a_page_range_that_is_not_numbers_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range that is not a number, or two joined by a dash, exits 2 and shows the form a range takes.

name: test_a_page_range_with_a_trailing_dash_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range written with a dash and no second number exits 2, rather than being read as the one page before the dash.

name: test_a_page_range_starting_before_page_1_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range starting at 0 exits 2 and says so, rather than printing the last page under the label page 0.

name: test_a_page_range_past_the_document_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range running past the last page exits 2 and says how many pages the document has, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_a_page_range_ending_before_it_starts_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range whose last page comes before its first exits 2 and says so, rather than printing a heading with nothing under it.

name: test_a_document_not_downloaded_exits_8
expected_result: Reading a document that is recorded but not on disk exits 8 and names the manifest to restore it from.

name: test_the_previous_sections_text_is_left_out_at_the_start
expected_result: When a section begins part way down a page, the text of the section before it on that page is left out of the extract.

name: test_the_next_sections_text_is_left_out_when_both_share_one_page
expected_result: When a section and the next both sit on one page, reading the first gives its own text and leaves out the next section's, so the two return different text.

name: test_the_next_sections_text_is_left_out_at_the_end
expected_result: When the next section begins on a section's last page, the next section's text on that page is left out of the extract.

name: test_a_page_with_a_picture_gets_the_not_shown_note
expected_result: A page holding a picture gets the NOT SHOWN note counting one image, so the gap in the text is visible.

name: test_a_page_with_a_table_gets_the_not_shown_note
expected_result: A page holding a ruled table gets the NOT SHOWN note counting one table.

name: test_a_ligature_is_decomposed_for_searching
expected_result: The searchable form of text holding the fi ligature, a single character standing for the two letters f and i, spells the word with its plain letters, so a search for the word finds it.

name: test_an_exact_section_number_beats_a_title_match
expected_result: A section whose number is exactly what was typed is chosen over an earlier section whose title merely contains it.

name: test_a_trailing_period_on_a_section_number_is_tolerated
expected_result: A section number typed with a trailing period finds the same section.

name: test_a_search_hit_names_the_section_it_falls_in
expected_result: A search hit on a document with bookmarks names the section its page falls in.

name: test_a_name_fragment_finds_the_workbook
expected_result: A fragment of a filename finds the one workbook it matches, so a nested path never has to be typed.

name: test_listing_names_every_sheet
expected_result: Naming a workbook without a sheet lists every sheet it holds.

name: test_listing_survives_a_sheet_without_a_dimension_record
expected_result: A workbook whose sheet file carries no dimension record, which some writers leave out, is still listed with its sheet named and the counts left blank, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_a_sheet_prints_as_a_table
expected_result: A named sheet prints as a table holding the cells it was written with.

name: test_a_sheet_name_matches_whatever_the_case
expected_result: A sheet name is matched whatever its case, so mainTimeline answers to maintimeline.

name: test_records_format_prints_one_field_per_line
expected_result: In records format each field is on its own line, which is what makes a sheet too wide for a table readable.

name: test_an_empty_cell_prints_as_nothing
expected_result: An empty cell prints as blank rather than as the word None, which would fill a sparse schedule grid with noise.

name: test_a_newline_inside_a_cell_does_not_break_the_row
expected_result: A cell holding a newline is printed on one line, so the row stays aligned.

name: test_find_reports_the_hits_in_one_workbook
expected_result: Searching one workbook reports each cell that contains the term by its sheet and row, rather than answering that no cell contains it.

name: test_find_with_no_hits_says_so_and_exits_0
expected_result: A search that matches nothing says so and exits 0, because finding nothing is an answer rather than a failure.

name: test_all_searches_every_workbook
expected_result: With --all the search covers every workbook under the inputs folder, not just one.

name: test_an_excel_lock_file_is_not_a_workbook
expected_result: A ~$ lock file that Excel leaves beside an open workbook is left out of discovery, because opening one raises rather than reading.

name: test_a_sheet_that_does_not_exist_exits_25
expected_result: Naming a sheet the workbook does not hold exits 25 and says to run without --sheet to list them.

name: test_a_workbook_that_matches_nothing_exits_26
expected_result: A name matching no workbook exits 26 and repeats the name that was looked for.

name: test_an_ambiguous_name_exits_26_listing_the_matches
expected_result: A fragment matching more than one workbook exits 26 and lists what it matched, so the next attempt can be exact.

name: test_all_without_find_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: Asking for --all without --find exits 2, the argument parser's own code, because it is a mistake in the command line rather than a failure to read anything.

name: test_no_workbook_named_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: Running with no workbook named exits 2 and lists the workbooks a person can name.

name: test_a_full_path_finds_the_workbook
expected_result: A workbook named by its full path is opened.

name: test_a_repo_relative_path_finds_the_workbook
expected_result: A workbook named by its path from the repo root is opened, whichever folder the command was started from.

name: test_a_filename_is_matched_whatever_its_case
expected_result: A filename typed in the wrong case finds the workbook.

name: test_a_long_cell_is_cut_short_with_an_ellipsis_in_a_table
expected_result: In table format a cell longer than the width limit is cut short and ends with an ellipsis, so one long note cannot push the other columns off the screen.

name: test_an_empty_field_is_skipped_in_records_format
expected_result: In records format a row's empty field is left out rather than printed as a header with nothing after it, which keeps a sparse grid readable.

name: test_a_search_reports_one_hit_per_row
expected_result: A row in which the term appears in two cells is reported once, since one line is enough to find the row.

name: test_a_search_hit_cuts_a_long_cell_short
expected_result: A hit in a cell longer than 120 characters shows the first 120 characters and an ellipsis, so one wide cell does not dominate the search output.
